```json
{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Tidy, recognizable flat-vector cartoon: grandstand with dot crowd, glowing sun, checkered finish post, leaderboard, and four legible horses with crouched jockeys. Anatomy is stiff (stick legs, slug-like necks) and rendering is flat, but nothing is blank, broken or malformed; edge-clipped horses are just mid-animation."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 4, "reason": "Nearly everything required is present: standalone 1200x800 SVG, no external refs/JS, sun, rails, lane dashes, finish checker column, four distinct coats/silks with numbered saddles, grandstand with roof/flags/crowd, leaderboard, PHOTO camera. Missing/invisible: clouds in the sky in all three frames, no visible hoof-dust, and not really a 'slightly elevated' angle."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Charming specific touches elevate it beyond template: a LEADERBOARD board listing THUNDER BAY / COPPER COMET / MIDNIGHT STAR / IVORY DASH with odds and 'TURF 2400m', a PHOTO finish camera on the post, roof flags, and foreground grass blades. Composition itself is fairly conventional."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Horses genuinely translate left-to-right at different speeds (positions clearly progress between the 400/1500/3800ms captures), legs cycle through gallop phases, tails/manes whip, bodies bob. Flaws: early loop shows no horses at all, right-edge teleport wrap is abrupt, and dust kick-up is not apparent in any frame."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 4, "reason": "Layered gradients (sky, grass, track, stand, roof), sun with rays, ~40 colored crowd dots, multi-line tote text, double rails with posts, dashed lane markings, drop shadow and foreground grass. Rich in the top band, though the vast track expanse and blank sky are thinly filled."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 3, "reason": "Balanced header band (stand left, board center, sun/post right) and harmonious bright palette, but two-thirds of the canvas is empty track with tiny horses bunched bottom-left by t=3800ms, frame 2 clips horses at the left edge, and the flat front view ignores the elevated-angle brief."},
  "summary": "A charming, technically solid animated race scene with real galloping translation and strong tote/grandstand detail, held back by invisible clouds, missing dust, empty track space and a flat frontal angle."
}
```
